label: Bible Study
prompt: For he shall be as a tree planted by the waters, and that spreadeth out her _____ by the river, and shall not see when heat cometh, but her leaf shall be green; and shall not be careful in the year of drought, neither shall cease from yielding fruit.
verse: For he shall be as a tree planted by the waters, and that spreadeth out her roots by the river, and shall not see when heat cometh, but her leaf shall be green; and shall not be careful in the year of drought, neither shall cease from yielding fruit.
note: A tree that doesn't panic in drought — 'careful' here is KJV for worried.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: For God hath not appointed us to wrath, but to obtain _____ by our Lord Jesus Christ,
verse: For God hath not appointed us to wrath, but to obtain salvation by our Lord Jesus Christ,
note: God's appointment for us isn't wrath — it's salvation. Good news worth keeping on the calendar.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And ere the _____ of God went out in the temple of the LORD, where the ark of God was, and Samuel was laid down to sleep;
verse: And ere the lamp of God went out in the temple of the LORD, where the ark of God was, and Samuel was laid down to sleep;
note: Before the lamp of God went out, young Samuel was asleep in the temple — and about to hear his name called.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And Jonah began to enter into the city a day's journey, and he cried, and said, Yet forty days, and Nineveh shall be _____.
verse: And Jonah began to enter into the city a day's journey, and he cried, and said, Yet forty days, and Nineveh shall be overthrown.
note: Jonah's one-line sermon didn't even mention repenting — and the whole city repented anyway.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Looking for that blessed hope, and the glorious _____ of the great God and our Saviour Jesus Christ;
verse: Looking for that blessed hope, and the glorious appearing of the great God and our Saviour Jesus Christ;
note: 'That blessed hope, and the glorious appearing' — the Second Coming, as Paul framed it for Titus on Crete.
